title: User can reset password via email
description: A registered user can request a password reset link via email. The link expires after 24 hours. Clicking a valid link shows a password reset form.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a registered user, when they click 'Forgot password' and submit their email, then a reset email is sent
Given a reset link, when clicked within 24 hours, then a password reset form is shown
Given an expired reset link, when clicked, then an error message 'Link expired' is shown
Given a password reset form, when a valid new password is submitted, then the password is updated and the user can log in with it
